reviews.text: Generally very good service. Reasonable prices.
It's amazing how they treat our fur babies here, I highly recommend them

Regarding the treatment and quality of service for my dogs, Ms. Thalia was always very good. My only issue, and the reason for my rating, is her lack of empathy. I was always punctual, and on one occasion, I made the huge mistake of not letting her know I couldn't bring my dogs. The reason was that my husband had suffered a stroke that morning, and she seemed very upset.
After that difficult time, weeks later, I wanted to reschedule, and Ms. Thalia said yes. But when she heard it was me, she said no, it wasn't possible after all. I explained the reason via WhatsApp, but she didn't seem to care much. And she didn't even reply. Her attitude was very regrettable.
Hertz looked so handsome after his bath! 🙂 Thank you! …

We were looking for a good place to bathe and fluff up Limón, close by and not too expensive. Finding something in the Roma neighborhood was a bit difficult, so I checked reviews of about 12 places nearby. Honestly, some of them look great, but the reviews show they're neglected and mistreat the dogs.

Milkie is close to us and quite affordable, and it had perfect reviews. They were super friendly when we called to ask if they had an opening for Limón, which was much appreciated because you can get treated a bit rudely in other areas.

They made Limón look gorgeous, with his bow and everything. I've attached proof: in short, THE BEST PLACE TO FLUFF UP YOUR DOG IN THE AREA.

Highly recommended. When you arrive, they ask if your dog has any allergies, surgeries, or anything like that. Limón came out super happy and smelling delicious! I'm so glad I found a place to take him for regular baths. I was bathing him at home, but he never looks as good as when a professional grooms him.

They trimmed his claws and removed all the knots. And it was really quick. When they finished, they sent us a picture of how beautiful he looked. One hundred stars!
Very professional, competent and very sweet with our dog!
Thank you so much!! 😊 We want to continue providing you with great service 🐕🤪 …
Excellent attention and service, highly recommended, my haircut turned out super cute 😊 …

I took my dog ​​for her first bath, and everything went very well. You can tell they treat the dogs with great care. They didn't keep her waiting long, and she was ready in less than an hour and a half.

They're also very empathetic with their owners. They take the time to keep you updated on how your dog is doing so you always have peace of mind. 🫶🫶
They are wonderful with dogs, they are very careful in the bathrooms, they sell single-ingredient treats like Izkis, my dog ​​loves them.
They have extensive experience and offer excellent care to fur babies.
Excellent service and outstanding treatment of the sandwiches, among the best in the city

Excellent service 💕 The best cat supplies for my kitty Paquita 🐱 They always have everything needed for cat care!!!
Highly recommended 😍 …
Excellent service, very loving with my dogs.

Great treatment of animals. Excellent service. Promotions. Almost always. Personalized attention. And above all, respect and care in the treatments and haircuts of the furry clients. Highly recommended.
Great place, the staff are top-notch
